definition: A ToolCall is a single invocation, by an agent, of a tool or function made available to it.
notes: A ToolCall is not the tool's registration/definition/schema itself
A ToolCall always belongs to exactly one AgentRun
A ToolCall may fail, succeed, or be canceled
examples: An agent calling a search_web function
An agent executing a sandboxed code interpreter tool
An agent invoking another service via an MCP tool call
counterExamples: A call to the underlying model itself (see ModelInvocation)
